verdict.rationale: The evidence shows external coding agents such as Claude Code connecting to Weave through the W&B MCP server and Skills. That is an integration point for third-party agents, not an AI assistant built into the product, so it earns no credit. The Playground is a prompt and model testing tool, not a delegable assistant, and nothing documents an in-product AI assistant that users can hand tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
